title: 2426. Number of Pairs Satisfying Inequality

examples.explanation: There are 3 pairs that satisfy the conditions: 1. i = 0, j = 1: 3 - 2 <= 2 - 2 + 1. Since i < j and 1 <= 1, this pair satisfies the conditions. 2. i = 0, j = 2: 3 - 5 <= 2 - 1 + 1. Since i < j and -2 <= 2, this pair satisfies the conditions. 3. i = 1, j = 2: 2 - 5 <= 2 - 1 + 1. Since i < j and -3 <= 2, this pair satisfies the conditions. Therefore, we return 3.
Since there does not exist any pair that satisfies the conditions, we return 0.
